fine_lines.title: good at vs good for
fine_lines.explanation_ar: good at + نشاط = تجيده. good for = مفيد لـ.
fine_lines.explanation_en: "Good at" = you do it well. "Good for" = helpful for.

examples.sentence: I am good at talking to people.
Exercise is good for your health.

fine_lines.title: I don't mind vs I don't like
fine_lines.explanation_ar: I don't mind = لا مانع لدي (مقبول). I don't like = لا أحب.
fine_lines.explanation_en: "I don't mind" = it's OK for me. "I don't like" = I am not happy with it.

examples.sentence: I don't mind working on weekends.
I don't like waking up late.

expressions.phrase: Can you tell me a little about yourself?
expressions.meaning_ar: هل يمكنك أن تحدثني قليلًا عن نفسك؟
expressions.example: Welcome. Can you tell me a little about yourself?

expressions.phrase: I recently graduated from college with a degree in ...
expressions.meaning_ar: تخرجت مؤخرًا من الجامعة بشهادة في ...
expressions.example: I recently graduated with a degree in Engineering.

expressions.meaning_en: Talking about what you learned at work.
expressions.example: I gained experience in customer service.

expressions.phrase: Can you tell me about a project you're proud of?
expressions.meaning_ar: هل يمكنك أن تحدثني عن مشروع تفخر به؟
expressions.example: Tell me about a project you're proud of.
What are you good at? I'm good at maths.

expressions.phrase: I like working with others and am comfortable in a team.
expressions.meaning_ar: أحب العمل مع الآخرين وأرتاح في العمل الجماعي.
expressions.meaning_en: Saying you are a team player.

expressions.phrase: I don't mind working on weekends.
expressions.meaning_ar: لا مانع لدي من العمل في عطلة نهاية الأسبوع.
expressions.meaning_en: Saying something is OK for you.
expressions.example: I don't mind travelling for work.

expressions.phrase: You seem like a good fit for the job.
expressions.example: You seem like a good fit for our team.

expressions.phrase: We'd like to offer you the job.
expressions.example: Congratulations! We'd like to offer you the job.

expressions.phrase: That's great news. I accept the offer.
expressions.example: Thank you! I accept the offer.
Thank you. I'm excited for the opportunity.

grammar.title: Talking about skills: can / be good at / be proficient in
grammar.explanation_ar: نتحدث عن المهارات بـ: I can + فعل، I'm good at + اسم أو V-ing، I'm proficient in + اسم.
grammar.explanation_en: Talk about skills with "can + verb", "good at + noun/-ing", "proficient in + noun".
examples: I am good at solving problems.

grammar.title: don't mind + -ing
grammar.explanation_ar: بعد don't mind نستخدم الفعل بـ ing.
examples: I don't mind working on weekends.
